description: A React component for displaying and managing a user grid in the Mattermost admin console, including pagination, search, filtering, and user role management.

classes.name: UserGrid
classes.description: A React component class for rendering a user management grid with pagination, filtering, and role editing features.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a specific page of users.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Loads the next page of users.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Loads the previous page of users.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles search input and resets to first page.

methods.name: onFilter
methods.description: Applies filter options and resets to first page.

methods.name: getVisibleTotalCount
methods.description: Calculates total user count considering included and excluded users.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Returns pagination start, end, and total counts.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Removes a user from the grid and adjusts pagination.

methods.name: newMembership
methods.description: Creates a new default membership object for a user.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates row data for the data grid based on current state and props.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the data grid.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the user grid component with pagination, filtering, and user management features.
